Ui.Tagline: Localization that reads like your code.
Ui.HomeTitle: FluentLocalizer · .NET localization with a Fluent API
Ui.HeroDescription: Build culture-aware messages with MessageFormat templates and a Fluent API. Keep localization logic expressive, predictable, and close to your application.
Ui.HeroVisual: A C# example that uses the Fluent API to format a greeting in English, Italian, French, German, and Spanish.
Ui.FeaturesDescription: From a simple hello to nuanced, culture-aware content, compose translations without wrestling with resource files or string builders.
Ui.WorkflowDescription: Write a message once. Supply values and a culture when you need it. FluentLocalizer handles the rest.
Ui.PackagesDescription: Three focused NuGet packages, designed to fit your application instead of dictating its architecture.
Ui.Versions: Versions shown reflect the package versions declared in this repository.
Ui.Experiment: Experiment with real FluentLocalizer formatting directly in your browser.
Ui.FluentDescription: Chain culture, arguments, and formatting calls in readable, maintainable C#.
Ui.NuanceDescription: Use placeholders, plural rules, and select expressions through the MessageFormat engine.
Ui.CultureDescription: Choose a culture per request and configure fallback behavior for missing translations.
Ui.ExtendDescription: Plug in your own translation store or use JSON storage and dependency injection packages.
Ui.CoreDescription: The translator, Fluent API, MessageFormat formatter, and store abstractions.
Ui.StorageDescription: File, embedded resource, and HTTP JSON stores for translation catalogs.
Ui.IntegrationDescription: Register translation services with Microsoft's dependency injection container.
Ui.NotFoundHelp: Try the overview or explore MessageFormat in the playground.
Ui.PlaygroundDescription: Write a template for each language, set its arguments, and see the real FluentLocalizer engine resolve it in your browser.
Ui.ExampleHelp: Choose a pattern, then make it yours in each language.
Ui.TabsHelp: Each tab has its own template. Select a language to edit and preview it; your other templates stay in place.
